title: M3.4 Qualified Release Set contradictory QA
purpose: Independently attack the exact frozen M3.4 Qualified Release Set product HEAD without modifying product code, and issue PASS only if all #328 fail-closed, determinism, scale, security and trust-boundary requirements survive.
invariants: Every verdict is bound to frozen product HEAD 41f2245e56b42a2e541d185f39a3edb5d8b6f01b.
No QA commit may modify any product path or promoted M3.2/M3.2.5/M3.3 authority.
A HOLD, tampered, inconsistent or evidence-contradictory FactoryRun must not enter a release set.
Exact kit bytes and canonical Atlas revision identities must remain fail-closed.
Cross-kit lineage/revision conflicts and duplicate logical inputs must not be silently counted.
Offline verification must reject unsafe, undeclared, missing, duplicate, non-regular, noncanonical or tampered archive state.
Release bytes and releaseSetId must be deterministic across ordering, path relocation and exact rebuilds.
Scale-100 and Scale-500 evidence is engineering-only and makes no semantic-qualification claim.
No network, GitHub/repository write, git push, provider/model dependency, learner-runtime mutation or remote publication is introduced.
Internal deterministic integrity and exact FactoryRun binding are in scope; publisher authentication and cryptographic signing are explicitly not provided; remote distribution trust is out of scope.
requiredEvidence: Exact three-path QA delta from the frozen product HEAD.
Frozen parent product branch remains exactly 41f2245e56b42a2e541d185f39a3edb5d8b6f01b while QA executes.
Frozen product regression oracle remains green before contradictory assertions execute.
Independent adversarial oracle covers all attack classes required by issue #328.
Any product defect is captured as a reproducible test failure and HOLD without product repair.
adversarialTests: 07 valid but wrong kit paired with a run
10 same packageRevisionId with differing digest and/or exact kit SHA
15 same revision ID with different digest or exact bytes
16 duplicate inputs must not be silently double-counted
24 changed ZIP compression or metadata / non-canonical archive
27 prior release remains independently verifiable after another release
30 exact rebuild byte identity and releaseSetId identity
31 homonymous titles with distinct canonical identities
32 different physical filenames for identical logical inputs
42 no source PDF, learner brief, separate semantic review, scratchpad or private author context in ZIP
46 exact binding to supplied FactoryRuns = YES
49 remote distribution trust = OUT OF SCOPE

candidateFindings.observed: A genuine HOLD FactoryRun was mutated only at factoryEvidence.verdict/reasons, top-level decision and evidenceBundle.finalDecision, then all deterministic hashes/runId were recomputed. reliability.verify_run accepted the internally rehashed object and release_set.build_release_archive admitted it despite embedded factoryEvidence.semanticReview.verdict remaining HOLD.
candidateFindings.expected: M3.4 admission must reject a forged PASS decision that contradicts embedded semantic-review evidence.
candidateFindings.failure: ReleaseSetInputError not raised : QA-WP-024 attack #3: release_set accepted a forged PASS whose embedded semanticReview verdict is HOLD

candidateFindings.observed: release-set.json was changed only from canonical JSON bytes to a pretty-printed byte representation of the exact same JSON object, then repacked with deterministic ZIP metadata. The archive bytes changed, but verify_release_archive still returned PASS under the unchanged releaseSetId.
candidateFindings.expected: Offline verification must reject tampered/noncanonical release-set.json bytes so a releaseSetId cannot verify multiple byte-distinct release ZIPs.
candidateFindings.failure: ReleaseSetInputError not raised : QA-WP-024 attack #25/#30: verifier accepted noncanonical release-set.json bytes, allowing different ZIP bytes under the same releaseSetId

nonGoals: Changing promoted FactoryRun, handoff, Atlas validation or learner runtime authorities.
Remote publishing, GitHub Releases automation, assets/media, catalog, backend, accounts, signing or provider integration.
Using author scratchpad or active author context as QA evidence.

execution.workflow: Atlas M3.4 Qualified Release Set Contradictory QA

productRegression.note: Frozen product test_release_set.py passed before the independent contradictory oracle.

execution.promotionEffect: PR #323 remains unmergeable by M3.4 project policy until the product lane repairs the confirmed defects, freezes a new product HEAD, reruns product CI, and obtains a fresh exact-head contradictory QA result.

rollback: Delete or revert only the three QA-WP-024 paths. No product or promoted upstream authority is modified.
independentReview: QA evidence is produced independently from issue #328, frozen product bytes, promoted read-only authorities, and QA-owned fixtures only; author scratchpad and author active context are excluded.
Any reproduced defect is reported against exact frozen product HEAD 41f2245e56b42a2e541d185f39a3edb5d8b6f01b and is not repaired in the QA lane.
A PASS is allowed only after every required adversarial class in issue #328 survives the independent oracle.
